title: The Mosquito: a past life story
html:

  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Atthakāmavagga Wanting to Help

4. Makasajātaka The Mosquito: a past life story

“Seyyo amitto matiyā upeto, Better is a considerate foe Na tveva mitto mativippahīno; than an inconsiderate friend. Makasaṁ vadhissanti hi eḷamūgo, Thinking, “I shall kill the mosquito”, Putto pitu abbhidā uttamaṅgan”ti. the idiot son split open his father’s head.

Makasajātakaṁ catutthaṁ.
